examples.title: E-Commerce Ordering
examples.description: A multi-context domain with ordering and fulfillment bounded contexts connected by event-driven flows.
examples.moment:
context "Ordering" [Core]

  aggregate "Order"
    identity orderId: UUID

    command PlaceOrder
      input customerId: UUID, items: OrderItem[]
      precondition orderNotPlaced: "Order has not already been placed"
      emits OrderPlaced

    command CancelOrder
      input orderId: UUID, reason: string
      precondition orderNotShipped: "Order must not have been shipped"
      emits OrderCancelled

    event OrderPlaced
      orderId: UUID
      customerId: UUID
      items: OrderItem[]
      placedAt: DateTime

    event OrderCancelled
      orderId: UUID
      reason: string
      cancelledAt: DateTime

  value-object OrderItem
    productId: UUID
    quantity: number
    unitPrice: Money

  invariant ORD-01 "Order must contain at least one item"
    scope Order
examples.gherkin:
# Generated by @mmmnt/generate

Feature: Order aggregate — Ordering context

  Scenario: Place a new order
    Given the Order aggregate exists
    And precondition "orderNotPlaced" holds:
      | Order has not already been placed |
    When command PlaceOrder is issued with:
      | customerId | <UUID>       |
      | items      | <OrderItem[]> |
    Then event OrderPlaced is emitted with:
      | orderId    | <UUID>       |
      | customerId | <UUID>       |
      | items      | <OrderItem[]> |
      | placedAt   | <DateTime>   |

  Scenario: Cancel an existing order
    Given the Order aggregate exists
    And precondition "orderNotShipped" holds:
      | Order must not have been shipped |
    When command CancelOrder is issued with:
      | orderId | <UUID>  |
      | reason  | <string> |
    Then event OrderCancelled is emitted with:
      | orderId    | <UUID>    |
      | reason     | <string>  |
      | cancelledAt | <DateTime> |

  Scenario: Invariant ORD-01 — Order must contain at least one item
    Given the Order aggregate exists
    When command PlaceOrder is issued with:
      | items | [] |
    Then the command is rejected
    And invariant ORD-01 is violated

examples.title: Veterinary Clinic
examples.description: A complex domain with reception and clinical contexts, sagas, policies, and cross-context flows.
examples.moment:
context "Reception" [Core]
  description "Manages patient check-in and registration"

  aggregate "PatientIntake"
    identity intakeId: UUID

    command CheckInPatient
      input patientId: UUID, ownerName: string,
            appointmentType: string
      precondition appointmentExists:
        "Patient must have a scheduled appointment"
      emits PatientCheckedIn

    command RegisterPatientIntake
      input validatedIntakeId: UUID, patientId: UUID
      emits PatientIntakeRegistered

    event PatientCheckedIn
      intakeId: UUID
      patientId: UUID
      ownerName: string
      appointmentType: string
      checkedInAt: DateTime

    event PatientIntakeRegistered
      intakeId: UUID
      patientId: UUID
      name: string
      species: string
      registeredAt: DateTime

  invariant REC-01
    "Patient must have valid identification"
    scope PatientIntake
examples.gherkin:
# Generated by @mmmnt/generate

Feature: PatientIntake aggregate — Reception context

  Scenario: Check in a patient with a scheduled appointment
    Given the PatientIntake aggregate exists
    And precondition "appointmentExists" holds:
      | Patient must have a scheduled appointment |
    When command CheckInPatient is issued with:
      | patientId       | <UUID>   |
      | ownerName       | <string> |
      | appointmentType | <string> |
    Then event PatientCheckedIn is emitted with:
      | intakeId        | <UUID>     |
      | patientId       | <UUID>     |
      | ownerName       | <string>   |
      | appointmentType | <string>   |
      | checkedInAt     | <DateTime> |

  Scenario: Invariant REC-01 — Patient must have valid ID
    Given the PatientIntake aggregate exists
    When command CheckInPatient is issued with:
      | patientId | <invalid> |
    Then the command is rejected
    And invariant REC-01 is violated
